title: get round — premier

translations.translation: 顺利应付；克服，说服某人同意原先反对的事

sentences.sentence: A clever lawyer might find a way of getting round that clause.
sentences.translation: 高明的律师也许能找到绕过那个条款的办法。

sentences.sentence: She knows how to get round her dad.
sentences.translation: 她知道怎样讨她爸爸的欢心。

sentences.sentence: As the great English writer George Eliot predicted over a century ago, that once established, the Jewish state will "shine like a bright star of freedom amid the despotisms of the East."
sentences.translation: 正如伟大的英国作家乔治·艾略特一个世纪以前所预言，一旦建立，这个犹太国家将“在东方的专制暴政中间像一颗明星一样发光”。

phrases.translation: 限制基金；处理船主责任范围以外的索赔的基金

sentences.sentence: a nuclear limitation treaty
sentences.translation: 核限制条约

sentences.sentence: a heroine of the French Resistance
sentences.translation: 法国抵抗运动的一位女英雄

sentences.sentence: Mira, the fictional heroine of ‘The Women’s Room’
sentences.translation: 迈拉，小说《女厕》的女主人公

sentences.sentence: The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
sentences.translation: 这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。

sentences.sentence: Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
sentences.translation: 妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。

sentences.sentence: We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
sentences.translation: 我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。

sentences.sentence: the single biggest obstacle to a Conservative victory in the next election
sentences.translation: 保守党在下一届大选中获胜的最大障碍

sentences.sentence: There are formidable obstacles on the road to peace.
sentences.translation: 通往和平的道路上存在难以逾越的障碍。

translations.translation: 具有讽刺意味的，讽刺的

sentences.sentence: Your car was stolen at the police station! How ironic!
sentences.translation: 你的车在警察局被偷！真让人哭笑不得！

sentences.sentence: It’s ironic that her husband smoked for thirty years, and yet she’s the one who died of lung cancer.
sentences.translation: 具有讽刺意味的是，她丈夫吸烟30年，而死于肺癌的却是她。

sentences.sentence: In an ironic twist , the most trustworthy character in the film turned out to be the thief.
sentences.translation: 影片中故事情节来了一个出乎意料的转折，最可信赖的人原来是小偷。

sentences.sentence: We tried to stop the flames from spreading, but we knew it was hopeless.
sentences.translation: 我们试图阻止火势蔓延，但我们知道这是不可能的。

sentences.sentence: Getting your work published often seems a hopeless task.
sentences.translation: 想让自己的作品出版似乎总是徒劳的。

sentences.sentence: I kept on struggling forward, even though I knew it was hopeless.
sentences.translation: 虽然知道无望，我还是奋力挣扎向前。

translations.translation: 用…… 的名字，在…… 的名字下

sentences.sentence: He made a few records under the name of Joe Ritchie.
sentences.translation: 他用乔∙里奇的名字录制了几张唱片。

translations.translation: 怀疑性的，持怀疑态度的

sentences.sentence: ‘You can trust me,’ he said. Jane looked sceptical.
sentences.translation: “你可以相信我。”他说。而简看上去一脸怀疑。

sentences.sentence: I saw through your little ruse from the start.
sentences.translation: 从一开始我就识破了你的小诡计。

sentences.sentence: She didn’t have the courage to admit to her deception.
sentences.translation: 她没有勇气承认自己的欺骗行为。

sentences.sentence: He was convicted of obtaining money by deception .
sentences.translation: 他被判犯有诈骗钱财罪。

立项；项目批准；项目许可

sentences.translation: 人群纷纷低声称是。

sentences.translation: 他的想法获得了公众广泛的赞同。

sentences.sentence: Does the design meet with your approval (=  do you like it?  ) ?
sentences.translation: 这个设计你喜欢吗？

sentences.sentence: Children are always seeking approval from their parents.
sentences.translation: 小孩子总是期待父母的赞许。

sentences.sentence: She looked to Greg for approval .
sentences.translation: 她指望格雷格同意。

sentences.sentence: The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
sentences.translation: 这个对比再清楚不过了。

sentences.translation: 清楚易懂的语法知识

sentences.translation: 绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。

sentences.translation: 与家人谈钱的问题要直截了当。

sentences.translation: 我们与时间斗争。

sentences.translation: 对教育改革直言不讳的批评者

sentences.translation: 你要怎么决定呢？其实你可以理性地去给予，或者根据启示去给予。

text:
英语词汇 · 人教高中 · 第 176 单元

get round
顺利应付；克服，说服某人同意原先反对的事
例句：A clever lawyer might find a way of getting round that clause.
高明的律师也许能找到绕过那个条款的办法。
例句：She knows how to get round her dad.
她知道怎样讨她爸爸的欢心。

George Eliot
乔治.艾略特
例句：As the great English writer George Eliot predicted over a century ago, that once established, the Jewish state will "shine like a bright star of freedom amid the despotisms of the East."
正如伟大的英国作家乔治·艾略特一个世纪以前所预言，一旦建立，这个犹太国家将“在东方的专制暴政中间像一颗明星一样发光”。

limitation
音标：英 /lɪmɪ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,lɪmɪ'teʃən/
n. 限制，局限性
短语：time limitation — 时间限制
短语：limitation of liability — 责任范围
短语：space limitation — 空间限制
短语：limitation period — 时效期
短语：limitation of actions — 诉讼时效
短语：limitation fund — 限制基金；处理船主责任范围以外的索赔的基金
例句：a nuclear limitation treaty
核限制条约

heroine
n. 女英雄；女主人公
例句：a heroine of the French Resistance
法国抵抗运动的一位女英雄
例句：Mira, the fictional heroine of ‘The Women’s Room’
迈拉，小说《女厕》的女主人公

obstacle
音标：英 /'ɒbstək(ə)l/  美 /'ɑbstəkl/
n. 障碍，阻碍
短语：obstacle course — n. 超越障碍训练场
例句：The tax puts obstacles in the way of companies trying to develop trade overseas.
这项税收为想在海外发展贸易的公司设置了障碍。
例句：Women still have to overcome many obstacles to gain equality.
妇女要获得平等仍需克服重重障碍。
例句：We want to remove all obstacles to travel between the two countries.
我们想要消除在这两个国家之间旅行的所有障碍。
例句：the single biggest obstacle to a Conservative victory in the next election
保守党在下一届大选中获胜的最大障碍
例句：There are formidable obstacles on the road to peace.
通往和平的道路上存在难以逾越的障碍。

ironic
音标：英 /aɪ'rɒnɪk/  美 /aɪ'rɑnɪk/
adj. 具有讽刺意味的，讽刺的
例句：Your car was stolen at the police station! How ironic!
你的车在警察局被偷！真让人哭笑不得！
例句：It’s ironic that her husband smoked for thirty years, and yet she’s the one who died of lung cancer.
具有讽刺意味的是，她丈夫吸烟30年，而死于肺癌的却是她。
例句：In an ironic twist , the most trustworthy character in the film turned out to be the thief.
影片中故事情节来了一个出乎意料的转折，最可信赖的人原来是小偷。

hopeless
音标：英 /'həʊpləs/  美 /ˈhoʊpləs/
adj. 没有希望的，绝望的
例句：We tried to stop the flames from spreading, but we knew it was hopeless.
我们试图阻止火势蔓延，但我们知道这是不可能的。
例句：Getting your work published often seems a hopeless task.
想让自己的作品出版似乎总是徒劳的。
例句：I kept on struggling forward, even though I knew it was hopeless.
虽然知道无望，我还是奋力挣扎向前。

under the name of
用…… 的名字，在…… 的名字下
例句：He made a few records under the name of Joe Ritchie.
他用乔∙里奇的名字录制了几张唱片。

sceptical
音标：英 /'skeptɪk(ə)l/  美 /'skeptikəl/
adj. 怀疑性的，持怀疑态度的
例句：‘You can trust me,’ he said. Jane looked sceptical.
“你可以相信我。”他说。而简看上去一脸怀疑。

see through
看破，识破
例句：I saw through your little ruse from the start.
从一开始我就识破了你的小诡计。

deception
音标：英 /dɪ'sepʃ(ə)n/  美 /dɪ'sɛpʃən/
n. 欺骗，诡计
例句：She didn’t have the courage to admit to her deception.
她没有勇气承认自己的欺骗行为。
例句：He was convicted of obtaining money by deception .
他被判犯有诈骗钱财罪。

approval
音标：英 /ə'pruːv(ə)l/  美 /əˈpruvl/
n. 赞成，承认
短语：approval of — 批准；同意
短语：examination and approval — 审查准许
短语：for approval — 提交批准
短语：approval process — 审批流程；审批手续；批准流程
短语：prior approval — 事先批准；预先审批；事前批准；事前许可；预先核准
短语：subject to approval — 需经批准；以确认为准
短语：final approval — 最后核准，最后批准
短语：approval authority — 批准机关；核准权
短语：approval documents — 批准文件
短语：written approval — 书面许可，书面批准
短语：certificate of approval — 合格证；批准证明书
短语：project approval — 立项；项目批准；项目许可
短语：unanimous approval — 一致通过
短语：official approval — 正式批准；官方批准
短语：on approval — [俚]供试用的；包退换的
短语：type approval — 型式批准
短语：approval procedure — 审核手续；批准程序
短语：win approval — 得到支持，获得通过
短语：seal of approval — 批准印章
短语：loan approval — 贷款批准；放款核准
例句：A murmur of approval passed through the crowd.
人群纷纷低声称是。
例句：His ideas have won widespread public approval (=  many people agree with them and think they are good  ) .
他的想法获得了公众广泛的赞同。
例句：Does the design meet with your approval (=  do you like it?  ) ?
这个设计你喜欢吗？
例句：Children are always seeking approval from their parents.
小孩子总是期待父母的赞许。
例句：She looked to Greg for approval .
她指望格雷格同意。

explicit
音标：英 /ɪk'splɪsɪt; ek-/  美 /ɪk'splɪsɪt/
adj. 直率的，明确的，清楚的
短语：explicit expression — 显式表达式
短语：explicit knowledge — 显性知识；外显知识
短语：explicit memory — 外显记忆
短语：explicit function — 显函数
短语：explicit formulation — 显式
例句：The contrast could not have been made more explicit.
这个对比再清楚不过了。
例句：explicit knowledge of grammar
清楚易懂的语法知识
例句：The kidnappers gave us explicit instructions not to involve the police.
绑匪明确告诉我们不许报警。
例句：Be explicit when you talk about money with your family.
与家人谈钱的问题要直截了当。

struggle against
与……作斗争
例句：We struggle against time.
我们与时间斗争。

outspoken
音标：英 /aʊt'spəʊk(ə)n/  美 /aʊt'spokən/
adj. 坦率直言的
例句：an outspoken critic of the education reforms
对教育改革直言不讳的批评者

growth
音标：英 /grəʊθ/  美 /ɡroθ/
n. 成长，生长
短语：economic growth — [经]经济增长，经济成长
短语：growth rate — 增长率；生长速率
短语：growth factor — 增长因子；增长系数；放大因子；经济增长因素
短语：population growth — 人口的增长
短语：plant growth — 植物生长
短语：fast growth — 快速生长
短语：growth pattern — 生长模型；生长模式
短语：steady growth — 稳步增长，增长平稳
短语：growth period — 生长期；成长期；发育期
短语：growth point — 增长点；发展中心
短语：crystal growth — 晶体生长
短语：growth potential — 增长潜力；生长势
短语：crack growth — 裂纹扩展；龟裂增长
短语：strong growth — 强劲增长；强劲的增长势头
短语：personal growth — 个人成长
短语：annual growth — 一年生长，年生长量
短语：sustainable growth — 可持续增长
短语：growth stage — n. 成长阶段
短语：growth hormone — n. [生化]生长激素；[生化]植物生长素
短语：growth hormone (gh) — [化]生长激素，促生长素
例句：Vitamins are essential for healthy growth.
维生素是健康成长所必需的。
例句：a means of stimulating plant growth
刺激植物生长的方法
例句：a growth hormone
生长激素

childhood
音标：英 /'tʃaɪldhʊd/  美 /'tʃaɪldhʊd/
n. 孩童时期，童年
短语：early childhood — 幼儿教育
短语：childhood education — 幼儿教育；儿童期教育
短语：early childhood education — 幼儿教育；儿童早期教育
短语：happy childhood — 快乐的童年
短语：childhood memory — 童年记忆；孩提时光
短语：childhood days — 少年时代，童年
短语：early childhood development — 幼儿期发展，儿童早期发展
短语：childhood autism — 儿童孤独症
例句：I had a very happy childhood.
我的童年很快乐。

hail
音标：英 /heɪl/  美 /hel/
v. 向……欢呼，打声招呼，呼喊
短语：hail from — （车、船）来自；（人）出生于
短语：hail storm — 冰雹风暴
例句：She leaned out of the window and hailed a passerby.
她探出窗户向一个路人大喊。

revelation
音标：英 /revə'leɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /'rɛvə'leʃən/
n. 启示，揭示
例句：So how do you decide? Well, you can give by reason or by revelation.
你要怎么决定呢？其实你可以理性地去给予，或者根据启示去给予。

premier
音标：英 /'premɪə; 'priː-/  美 /prɪ'mɪr/
adj. 第一的，首要的
短语：premier league — 超级联赛
短语：vice premier — 副总理
例句：one of Dublin’s premier hotels
都柏林最好的酒店之一
